messages:
ivy: heads-up: deploybot blocked a publish for auth-proxy:2026.04.05 because the same short tag exists in two repo prefixes. automatic promote skipped to avoid serving a different manifest than expected.

deploybot: publish blocked for `auth-proxy:2026.04.05`
reason: tag collision detected across repositories: `registry.redwood.io/auth-proxy` and `registry.redwood.io/edge/auth-proxy`. refusing automatic promote.

omar: that's new — why are we seeing duplicate unqualified tags under edge/?

release-ci: edge mirror pipeline started publishing quick-test builds with the same semver tags to speed QA. it was supposed to use a suffix but the job missed it on April 3.

ivy: we need this image in staging for the integration test run tomorrow morning. can we do a safe manual promote?

ops: recommended manual flow: copy the canonical digest (from the canonical repo) into a staging-qualified repo and pin deploy to that digest. don't reuse the ambiguous short tag.

sam: concrete commands to run in the change window (verify creds first):
```
# get canonical digest from the canonical repo
docker manifest inspect registry.redwood.io/auth-proxy:2026.04.05 | jq -r '.config.digest'
# copy exact digest to a staging-qualified repo without touching tags
skopeo copy \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/auth-proxy@sha256:9f3b...a1e7 \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/staging/auth-proxy:promote-2812345678 --preserve-digests
# sanity-check cosign attestation (if present)
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/... registry.redwood.io/staging/auth-proxy@sha256:9f3b...a1e7
# pin deploybot to the staging digest
deploybot set-pin --service=auth-proxy --env=staging --image=registry.redwood.io/staging/auth-proxy@sha256:9f3b...a1e7
```

omar: add a tiny healthcheck that hits `/health` and a smoke request to the auth proxy after pin. rollback if failing checks or >3% errors in first 10m.

ivy: change window: 04:30 UTC for 25 minutes tomorrow. i'll be on-call to run and monitor.

release-ci: i'll include a release-note snippet saying we used a region-qualified digest and why (tag collision). also will link the staging deployment in the release changelog.

ops: extra safety: temporarily mark the edge mirror prefix as "reject-unqualified-tags" in the publish pipeline so future pushes require suffixing. i'll open a quick fix PR.

sam: file a lint ticket to block promotion of an unqualified tag when the same tag exists in multiple repo prefixes; deploybot should surface that earlier.

ops: ticket filed: https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/INF-9991 6 includes publish-lint and mirror-fix.

omar: PR with promote steps + healthcheck + small revert script opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/2001 16 tagging @ivy @sam @ops.

ivy: thanks. i will run the promote during the window and paste logs here. posting provisional rollback criteria: revert if healthcheck fails, or latency p95 increases >300ms, or error rate >3% during the 15-minute post-deploy monitoring.

deploybot: note: automated retries remain disabled for tag-collision events. manual operator action required.

sam: :thumbsup: once done, we'll update the release notes and remove the temporary staging-qualified tag after the canary completes.

ivy: done for now — will follow up after the 04:30 run.
